name: duet
description: Duet: Claude and Codex working as one build pipeline, so the model that is good at facts establishes them before the model that is good at judgement writes the code.

plugins.name: duet
plugins.description: Claude and Codex as one build pipeline. Codex establishes current documentation, real API surfaces, dependency versions, supply-chain safety and tests; Claude owns grilling, spec, architecture, logic and design. Built to stop the failure where an AI confidently writes an API call that was removed two versions ago.
